content: WhatsApp Web media handling feature surface (cross-checked, MEDIUM): media is a two-step upload-then-send with type-specific HKDF key derivation keyed by MediaType (Image/Video/Audio/Document/History/AppState); downloads decrypt+verify HMAC/SHA256 and can fail with 403/404 (media expired) — WhatsApp removes old media from servers and recovery requires another linked device to re-upload (media retry receipt flow: SendMediaRetryReceipt + DecryptMediaRetryNotification, error 2 = 'media no longer available on phone'). Send surface across libs: image, video, audio (ptt voice note flag), document (fileName+caption), sticker (WebP+dimensions), contact card, location, view-once, thumbnail/link-preview images. whatsmeow exposes Upload/Download/DownloadAny/DownloadThumbnail plus newsletter variants; Baileys exposes downloadContentFromMessage and updateMediaMessage re-upload.
